title: Fix KMS Decrypt Plaintext DEK Zeroization

transitions.note: Created from unresolved PR #78 review finding.
Ensure AWS SDK Decrypt plaintext buffer is wiped immediately after copying, matching GenerateDataKey handling.
Initial CI passed all required checks and regression test confirmed SDK plaintext zeroization.
Branch rebuilt on current main after infrastructure merge; same minimal security fix reapplied cleanly.

notes: Critical memory-lifetime hardening. Decrypt now uses copyAndWipeSensitiveBytes; no env, AWS resource, database, route or traffic changes.
